content.title: 现在分词(V-ing)作表语和定语 速查
content.intro: 现在分词(V-ing)表示主动、正在进行的动作或性质。作表语描述事物给人的感受(物用 -ing,人用 -ed);作前置/后置定语,相当于一个主动的形容词或定语从句(who/which is doing)。

headers: 位置 / 例句 / 等价
rows: be + V-ing:The film is amazing.(物的性质;人则用 -ed:I am amazed.)
V-ing + 名词:exciting news / the rising sun / running water(主动·进行)
名词 + V-ing 短语:the man standing there = who is standing there
物用 -ing(exciting),人用 -ed(excited);The news is exciting / I am excited.

specialRules.rule: 描述事物'令人……'的性质或感受 → 用 V-ing
specialRules.mark: These lanterns are amazing.(amazing 修饰物)
I was amazed by the lanterns.(amazed 修饰人)

specialRules.rule: 后置定语 = 主动的定语从句(who/which is doing),被修饰名词是动作发出者
specialRules.mark: families celebrating the festival = who are celebrating it

specialRules.rule: 短语作后置定语;单个分词常前置
specialRules.mark: the shining moon(前置) / the moon shining brightly(短语后置)

why: 现在分词来自动词,保留'主动·进行'的意义:作定语时,名词是动作的发出者(the running water = water that is running);作表语时,说明主语本身具有'使人……'的性质,所以物用 -ing、人用 -ed。
gaokaoPoints: -ing 与 -ed 的辨析(物 vs 人:exciting/excited、boring/bored、moving/moved)是语法填空与单选高频考点。
现在分词作后置定语 vs 过去分词作后置定语:主动/进行用 V-ing(the man standing),被动/完成用 V-ed(the gifts left under the tree)。

examVsReal.real: 口语里也常说 The story is so touching / really moving
examVsReal.note: 考试重点是分清 -ing(物)与 -ed(人),口语用法一致但更随意

examVsReal.exam: the families celebrating the festival(后置定语·书面)
examVsReal.real: the families who are celebrating the festival
examVsReal.note: 考试爱用分词压缩从句,口语里两种都自然
